title: Entity Type
description: Validates entity type definitions in behavior packs. Checks format_version against the current Minecraft version and can update format versions to the latest.

52.title: Runtime Identifier
52.description: Aggregates runtime_identifier values from entity type definitions. Runtime identifiers inherit behavior from vanilla entities.
52.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the runtime_identifier string.

53.title: Entity Identifier
53.description: Aggregates identifier values from entity type definitions. Shows which vanilla entity identifiers are being overridden.
53.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the entity identifier string.

54.title: Entity Metadata
54.description: Aggregates metadata about entity types including aliases and properties defined in entity descriptions.

100.title: Format Version Undefined
100.description: Checks that the entity type definition has a format_version field defined.

110.title: Major Version Low
110.description: The entity type format_version major version is lower than the current Minecraft version. Consider updating to access new features.

111.title: Major Version High
111.description: The entity type format_version major version is higher than the current Minecraft version. This indicates an invalid future version.

120.title: Minor Version Low
120.description: The entity type format_version minor version is lower than the current Minecraft version. Consider updating for compatibility.

121.title: Minor Version High
121.description: The entity type format_version minor version is higher than the current Minecraft version. This indicates an invalid future version.

130.title: Patch Version Low
130.description: The entity type format_version patch version is lower than the current Minecraft version. Consider updating for the latest fixes.

131.title: Patch Version High
131.description: The entity type format_version patch version is higher than the current Minecraft version. This indicates an invalid future version.

500.title: Version Retrieval Failed
500.description: Internal error: Could not retrieve the latest Minecraft version from the database.

501.title: Version Parse Failed
501.description: Internal error: Could not parse the latest Minecraft version string into version components.
501.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the version string that failed to parse.
